units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 41:7">Gen. R. s. 41</cite> <he>כשאדם רע קורין אותו ס׳</he> when a man is bad, they call him a Sodomite; <cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 7:23">Tosef. Sabb. VII</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 8:23">VIII</cite>), 23.

<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 8:24">Ib. 24</cite>; a. fr.—Pl. <he>סְדוֹמִיִּים</he>, <cite ref="O00180"><he>סְדוֹמִים</he></cite>, <cite ref="O00180"><he>סְדוֹמִין</he></cite>, <cite ref="O00209"><he>סוֹדָ׳</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 26">Gen. R. s. 26</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 44:1">Yalk. ib. 44</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Batra 2:4:2">Y. B. Bath. II, 13ᶜ</cite> top <he>כותל סודמין</he> a wall of the Sodomites’, i.e. a wall which may not have windows looking into the adjoining lot.
